summary: Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on June 22, 2026, reporting a tragic loss-of-life incident at its Moab Khotsong mine in South Africa. The report details a seismicity-related fall-of-ground incident on June 19, 2026, resulting in one employee fatality. Management is providing support, an investigation led by the Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources is underway, and the company expresses condolences. This is a routine disclosure of an operational safety incident, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, strategic actions, or corporate events that fit any special-situation category.
